issue.title: Fix dropped ignore above fields

issue.body:
Currently, the `CompositeSyntheticFieldLoaders` for the various text-family field mappers only load the stored fields containing the original non-ignored values if ignore_above is set to a non-default value. But if a value is ignored due to hitting a default ignore_above limit, it won't be loaded by the field loader. This PR corrects that logic.

Fixes #137360.

body:
In our code, we have two default values for `ignore_above`: 8191 for logsdb indices and `Integer.MAX_VALUE` for everything else. If `ignore_above` is explicitly configured to either of these, we treat it as not being set. This is a bit counterintuitive, but we've always done it like this.

So this [line ends](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/ac0bc487771aa0405dbd50dcbae3b0803b7fac84/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/KeywordFieldMapper.java#L1410) up evaluating to false.
